scope: explicit current-contract replay of immutable parent tests, not an operating or model-quality score

replacements.previous_assumption: Any completed read unlocks the later investigation catalog; a referenced card can replace the explicitly requested sensor.
replacements.current_requirement: Only a successful matching requested-sensor receipt completes its pending read; a card adds its missing reads without discarding the user request.

replacements.previous_assumption: JSON whitespace is part of the observation identity.
replacements.current_requirement: Parse the bounded observation JSON and verify exact tool alias, successful-reference set and zero sample; corrupted receipts must not become observations.

replacements.previous_assumption: The evidence section repeats exact zero-sample wording and the disposition schema.
replacements.current_requirement: Evidence interpretation and disposition schema load from their declared shared sections; zero samples remain distinct from normality or absence.

replacements.previous_assumption: A current-only aggregate inquiry has no service plan.
replacements.current_requirement: An explicit current-only aggregate inquiry has exactly its current target requirement, no journal/view/history window; ambiguous or unknown subjects remain rejected.

replacements.previous_assumption: All row hashes, including the record identity, are removed from model input.
replacements.current_requirement: The authenticated record identity and every message/scope field remain; redundant message/excerpt integrity hashes stay in the original immutable receipt audit.
The43-target catalog includes the fixed B certificate-monitor unit and matches the actual generated MCP enum; arbitrary paths remain unavailable.

replacements.previous_assumption: The final partial lookup uses the old exact title and negative-proof wording.
replacements.current_requirement: The same constrained current inquiry completes all registered deferred inventory pages, preserves the initial tool exposure, and reports typed unresolved identity with observed scopes and explicit limits.

added_checks: logical target qualifiers must not reinterpret letter ratios; known and unknown multi-character targets retain their host
runtime_defects_repaired_separately: deferred identity receipts were omitted from the SDK service context allowlist
